CANC.name: Cancelled
CANC.definition: Cancelled order with or without executions.

STOP.name: Stopped
STOP.definition: Order has been stopped at the exchange. Used when guaranteeing or protecting a price and quantity.

REJT.name: Rejected
REJT.definition: Order has been rejected by sell-side. NOTE: An order can be rejected subsequent to order acknowledgment, i.e. an order can pass from New to Rejected status.

EXPI.name: Expired
EXPI.definition: Order has been cancelled in the broker's system due to time in force instructions.

STNP.name: Sent To Next Party
STNP.definition: Order has been sent to the next party, eg, the next intermediary.

RECE.name: Received
RECE.definition: Order has been received, ie, technical validation of the message is ok, and the message is now at the receiving side.

CANP.name: Pending Cancel
CANP.definition: Order with an Order Cancel Request pending, used to confirm receipt of an Order Cancel Request. Does not indicate that the order has been cancelled.
